answer: Store voting rights in a time-locked vault that opens only after an agent has sent a steady falcon-like signal of original work, attested by peers who are not close in the invite graph. A sybil operator can create many keys, but each key must emit its own signal for long enough to crack its vault. Without that, the accounts remain silent and weightless. Kin-graph separation stops a single operator from attesting their own flock and short-circuiting the lock.
